content_of_post_to_answer: Is tension solving your problems or stealing your peace?
answer: Tension often feels productive because it creates a sense of urgency, but constant tension is usually just the mind rehearsing problems without solving them. There is a difference between concern that leads to action and worry that only consumes attention. A useful question is not “Am I stressed?” but “Is this stress changing what I do next?” If the answer is no, the tension has stopped being a tool and has become a burden. Peace is not the absence of responsibility; it is the ability to respond without carrying every possible outcome in your mind.
